title: Human-guided physics-constrained AI agents construct an auditable model of soil-plug evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.23360v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Engineering predictions require physical mechanisms to be translated consistently into equations, discretization, code, and validation, yet errors can propagate despite local checks. Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents automate scientific tasks, but coordinating and independently auditing the theory-to-solver process under physical constraints and human oversight remains unresolved. We introduce a human-in-the-loop, physics-constrained multi-agent workflow where human experts define admissible physics and modeling boundaries, while agents retrieve evidence, derive equations, implement solvers, and audit the theory-to-code chain. Applied to soil-plug evolution during suction-caisson installation, the workflow generated and audited 6 formulations in 2.9 h of agent execution once physical knowledge and inputs were prepared. Among these formulations, adding seepage-driven soil void-ratio evolution to the geometric baseline reduced mean abs

translated_title: 人类引导的物理约束AI智能体构建可审计的土塞演化模型
translated_abstract: 工程预测需要将物理机制一致地转化为方程、离散化、代码和验证，然而即使存在局部检查，误差仍可能传播。人工智能（AI）智能体能够自动化科学任务，但在物理约束和人类监督下，如何协调并独立审计从理论到求解器的全过程仍未得到解决。我们提出了一种人在回路、物理约束的多智能体工作流，其中人类专家定义可容许的物理机制和建模边界，而智能体负责检索证据、推导方程、实现求解器并审计从理论到代码的链条。将该工作流应用于负压沉箱安装过程中的土塞演化问题，在准备好物理知识和输入后，该工作流在2.9小时的智能体执行中生成了6种公式并完成了审计。在这些公式中，在几何基线基础上加入渗流驱动的土体孔隙比演化，使平均绝对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种人在回路、物理约束的多智能体AI工作流，由人类专家定义物理机制与建模边界，AI智能体自动完成证据检索、方程推导、求解器实现及理论到代码链条的审计，并成功应用于负压沉箱安装中的土塞演化建模，在2.9小时内生成并审计了6种公式。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a human-in-the-loop, physics-constrained multi-agent AI workflow in which human experts define admissible physics while AI agents retrieve evidence, derive equations, implement solvers, and audit the theory-to-code chain, generating and auditing 6 formulations of soil-plug evolution during suction-caisson installation within 2.9 hours.
